notes.title: Playtest build update + computer issues
notes.content:
[p]Ok, first things first, the playtest build.
Before, I shared a drive link so you could access the playtest build.
Now I'd like to announce that I set up an itchio page where you can access the build as well.
Here's the link to that:[/p][p][url="https://knucklesthechuckles.itch.io/night-of-the-abattoir-man-true-ending-playtesting-buiold"]https://knucklesthechuckles.itch.io/night-of-the-abattoir-man-true-ending-playtesting-buiold[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Over this week I've been updating the playtest build with fixes and some new content that was suggested to me so ya'll might wanna give that a try.
Here's one of the cool things I added. Animated portraits, like in doom and pizza tower!

[/p][previewyoutube="GufCSWITcJw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Sencondly the computer issues.
Yes, for almost a year now I've been having issues with my computers battery. Basically it doesn't charge any more. This isn't that big of an issue and I can just keep it plugged when I use it but I'd rather have it fixed before the warranty goes out.
What this means is that I most likely won't have my pc for about a month, maybe longer. The only computer I'll have available is my old 4gb laptop from 2014, which was actually the computer I used when I began making Night of the Abattoir Man back in 2023. It's not aq very good computer and I'm absolutely not gonna work on the game with it because of how slow it is. I can work on concepts and ideas though but I can do any work on the game itself.[/p][p]So if you guys wanna help me out, please play the playtest build, share it with other people and just go at it and tell me all thats wrong with it and all the bugs that happen. Join the discord so you can tell me.[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/Wd6MdDVWQ9"]https://discord.gg/Wd6MdDVWQ9[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Once I get my pc back I'll be able to work on the game again and use all of your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Other than that, thank you everyone, have a good one.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047189/65a45aba67ae217143f50fd480464977a24d7a0c.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Quick Update on Progress
notes.content:
So, what have I been doing so far?
Well a few things.
Mostly, I've been working on some writing.
I’ve also been working on a map, I got an interesting idea for this one but I won’t go too much into it. No spoilers.
But I did record a little sneak peek of what I’ve been working on.

[previewyoutube=jCORMRl9Chw;full][/previewyoutube]

Hopefully I'll be able to get the update finished before the end of the year. I see no reason why it should take that long to complete it.
If everything goes well, this update might outdo the current game.

notes.title: News on the True Ending Update?
notes.content:
Hello everyone.
I'm writting this just to keep everyone up to date on the progress on the True Ending Update and this whole game in general.
As I mentioned before, I'm more focused on finishing my masters degree right now, it's almost complete. This means that the game is taking a slight back seat for now.
This, however, does not mean that I have been working on the update at all. Granted, work has been slow. For the most part, I've done some writing for some cutscenes I’m planning, drew one new character and have been coming up with ideas for maps and mechanics. 
I understand this is not much but as I said, I've been busy.
Rest assured, I have not forgotten about this game, I have so many plans that I want to put into practice and I can’t wait to be able to focus on this game once more.
Thank you to everyone who has played this game and left reviews, it really means a lot to me.
Once again I ask, if you come across any weird bug and glitches, please post them on the discussion tab or join our discord group, I want this game to be as bug free as possible.
Thank you to everyone.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047189/52cbc7144cb6ed27b1ea8bf8d6a77d3bc74dd8ad.png[/img]

notes.title: 4 new achievements added
notes.content:
Added 4 new achievements
These should be all the achievevements I'll add until we release the True Ending Update which will have it's own achievements.
If you have any suggestions for more achievements please feel free to tell me.

notes.title: Fixed achievements
notes.content: Fixed a problem that would  cause some achievements to be unobtainable

notes.title: Fixed a minigame not unlocking after collecting the floppy disk
notes.content:
Fixed a mistake in the game that caused the minigame "The Space Canter" from not unlocking even despite the player having collected that floppy disk.
Now, if you have already collected that disk, the minigame should be unlocked.
Please tell me if this is not the case

notes.title: Updated the fishing minigame
notes.content: Added an on screen score counter and added the Goldfish, a fish that's worth 200 points

notes.title: Update notes
notes.content:
- The killer can no longer be blocked off during the final chase sequence
- For performance reasons, the player can no longer use Rosary Beads during the final chase sequence
- f12 no longer resets the game, meaning the player can now screenshot the game
- Alt+Enter no longer fullscreens the game

notes.title: Quick update
notes.content: Fixed a mistake that caused the killer to be perpetually stunned by bear traps in the first level

notes.title: Quick fix for a bug
notes.content: Fixed a bug that prevented the player from throwing knives in the second phase of the secret boss when playing as the killer

notes.title: Quick update
notes.content:
patch notes:

-fixed a few spelling mistakes

-While playing as the killer, you will no longer phase through white chests

-Hopefully fixed a problem that causes the game to crash when you lose to the secret boss

notes.title: Some more small fixes
notes.content:
patch notes:

Fixed a random missing sound crash 

Fixed a bug where if the player was hiding and used a taser knife on the killer and instantly left the hiding spot before the animation finished it would cause the killer to walk around stunned forever. To fix this, the player is no longer allowed to use the taser knife when hiding.

Fixed a random graphical glitch where opened locker container had blue pixels instead of being fully red

Fixed a problem where if the player stepped on a bear trap and hid inside a carboard box the killer would still go to the player

notes.title: Autosave system has been fixed
notes.content: Fixed a problem that was causing the autosave system to not work properly

notes.title: First proof reading update
notes.content:
I went and did some proof reading and tried to fix a bunch of the writing.
Most likely, there's still a lot to fix.
If you find any mistakes in the writing, please warn me and tell me where you found it
Thank you

notes.title: Update 1.2 has been released
notes.content:
patch notes:

-Fixed some pathing issues in the final level that were causing performance issues

-Fixed a bug in the final level were the killer was unable to spot the player

-Fixed the volume issue on some of the voice lines

-The player can no longer run while using a cardboard box

-The killer will now be alerted when the player gets caught by a bear trap

-The player can now go back in certain maps, more specifically in the begining

-New volume menu has been added, replacing the old one

-The volume menu now appears in the main menu

-The player now no longer needs to press Z to push yellow objects, now they only need to hold z to push it
